title:
THE CROZIER AND THE PEN
 
 —His grace phoned down twice this morning, Red Murray said gravely.
 
 They watched the knees, legs, boots vanish. Neck.
 
 A telegram boy stepped in nimbly, threw an envelope on the counter and stepped off posthaste with a word:
 
 —Freeman!
 
 Mr Bloom said slowly:
 
 —Well, he is one of our saviours also.
html_source:
Yet another comparison.

Crozier

ACCEPTED SUGGESTION: “His grace” alludes to both editor and the real Archbishop Walsh.
